seoTitle: Hreflang Tag Generator for Language and Region URLs
metaDescription: Generate HTML or XML hreflang annotations for language and regional versions of a page.
intro: Generate HTML or XML hreflang annotations for language and regional versions of a page.
aboutTitle: How should localized pages link to each other?
about: Each version should list itself and the other versions in the same set. Use full URLs and select the correct language and optional region for each page.
example: Add the English and French article URLs, assign their language codes and generate HTML head tags. Add the matching annotations to both pages.

faqs.question: When should I use x-default?
faqs.answer: Add x-default when you have a fallback URL, such as a language selector for visitors without a matching version.
